programs.name: Adapted CampTO Explore
programs.description: Adapted CampTO Explore is a fun and creative camp experience for campers with a special need or a disability. Enjoy modified active and quiet games, arts and crafts, sports and more while making new friends. A workshop, a local trip or a visit from a special guest will add to the excitement.Participants must have a current AIS membership. For membership information contact the AIS Hotline at 416-395-6128 or email aiscw@toronto.ca.

programs.name: CampTO Plus: Creative Writing
programs.description: This camp is for those who have a story to tell. Come share your stories with us as you learn the basics of writing with a focus on thought organization, plot and character development.In addition to the minimum two hours a day focusing on developing and fine-tuning your creative writing skills, you will also enjoy games, arts, sports and swim days dependent on weather and camp location. A trip or on-site special experience will be included, such as themed events, clinics or workshops to further enhance the camp.

programs.name: CampTO Plus: Cycling - Advanced (On the Road)
programs.description: If you already know how to ride a bike, this camp is great way to take your cycling to the next level. Learn how to ride safely and skillfully on residential streets, through guided practice and instruction. In addition to the minimum two hours a day focusing on developing and fine-tuning your cycling skills, you will also enjoy games, arts, sports and swim days dependent on weather and camp location. A trip or on-site special experience will be included, such as themed events, clinics or workshops to further enhance the camp.Equipment: Campers must bring their own bicycle helmet and a working bicycle with a bell and lock.

programs.name: CampTO Plus: Island Voyager
programs.description: Climb on board our ferries to be transported to the City's oasis, Toronto Island, and explore the challenges of being a voyager on the water. Here you will travel across the island, from the boathouse to the lagoons and the Gibraltar Lighthouse, to learn and practice canoeing, kayaking, portaging as well as fishing.  You will also learn about indigenous wildlife on the island and will take part in the arts through an environmental lens. Exploring activities on the different Islands will enable campers to hear stories and view curiosities. The ferry fee is included in the cost of the camp.

Through drills, practice and games, enhance your skills and have some fun.In addition to the minimum two hours a day focusing on developing and fine-tuning your sport skills, you will also enjoy games, arts, sports and swim days dependent on weather and camp location. programs.name: Cardio Dance
programs.description: Cardio dance is a dynamic and exciting aerobic workout that anyone can enjoy. With a focus on various culturally inspired music and dance movements and a goal of lifting your heart rate you will dance your way to new fitness heights.

programs.name: Cardio Dance: Bollywood
programs.description: Bollywood moves and Bhangra steps inspire this energetic cardio workout. Combining classical Indian and folk dance steps with expressive body movements, you will dance your way to new fitness heights.

programs.name: Cardio: Kickboxing
programs.description: Calling all fitness warriors. This high-intensity cardio workout that incorporates non-contact punches, kicks and athletic moves will help you improve your strength, balance and coordination.

programs.name: Cardio: Rebounder
programs.description: Save your joints from discomfort with this low-impact workout that uses a mini trampoline to support movement. Classes will include both cardio and multi-muscle exercises to help you improve your balance, coordination and endurance.

programs.name: Challenge Swim: Bronze
programs.description: Take on the challenge of improving your fitness and endurance. In this first level of the Challenge Swim program you will learn backstroke starts and somersaults for flip turns while continuing to work on interval training and swimming drills. Work towards a 200-metre continuous swim in a non-competitive environment where you will aim to improve your swim times and skills.Prerequisite: Successful completion or skill ability equal to Ultra Swim 7.

programs.name: Challenge Swim: Bronze
programs.description: Take on the challenge of improving your fitness and endurance. In this first level of the Challenge Swim program you will learn backstroke starts and somersaults for flip turns while continuing to work on interval training and swimming drills. Work towards a 200-metre continuous swim in a non-competitive environment where you will aim to improve your swim times and skills.Prerequisite: Successful completion or skill ability equal to Ultra Swim 7.

programs.name: Challenge Swim: Gold
programs.description: Take on the challenge of improving your fitness and endurance. In this third and final level of the Challenge Swim program you will learn relay starts while continuing to work on interval training and swimming drills. Work towards a 500-metre continuous swim in a non-competitive environment, where you will aim to improve your swim times and skills.Prerequisite: Successful completion or skill ability equal to Ultra Swim 7 or Challenge Silver.

programs.name: Challenge Swim: Gold
programs.description: Take on the challenge of improving your fitness and endurance. In this third and final level of the Challenge Swim program you will learn relay starts while continuing to work on interval training and swimming drills. Work towards a 500-metre continuous swim in a non-competitive environment, where you will aim to improve your swim times and skills.Prerequisite: Successful completion or skill ability equal to Ultra Swim 7 or Challenge Silver.

programs.name: Challenge Swim: Silver
programs.description: Take on the challenge of improving your fitness and endurance. In this second level of the Challenge Swim program, you will learn about relay dynamics, breaststroke and butterfly starts while continuing to work on flip and stroke turns, interval training and swimming drills. Work towards a 400-metre continuous swim in a non-competitive environment where you will aim to improve your swim times and skills.Prerequisite: Successful completion or skill ability equal to Ultra Swim 7 or Challenge Bronze.

programs.name: Challenge Swim: Silver
programs.description: Take on the challenge of improving your fitness and endurance. Work towards a 400-metre continuous swim in a non-competitive environment where you will aim to improve your swim times and skills.Prerequisite: Successful completion or skill ability equal to Ultra Swim 7 or Challenge Bronze.

programs.name: Community Leadership After-School Program (CLASP)
programs.description: Are you seeking recreational care at the end of the school day? Community Leadership After School Program (CLASP) offers outdoor play, crafts, sports, games and physical literacy. Participants will receive homework help, nutritional education and a snack while focusing on social interactions and wellness.

programs.name: Computers: Laptop
programs.description: Designed for first-time users or those with some knowledge, this introduction to computers focuses on how to use a device with confidence. Learn basic computer skills like navigation as well as how to create an email, access the web, create documents and more.Equipment: Use of computers vary by location, please check ahead. You may bring a laptop.

programs.name: Cooking

programs.name: Counsellor in Training
programs.description: Becoming a camp counsellor is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. In this camp, you will learn about program planning and working with campers in an interactive environment. You will also get the opportunity to do a supervised practical placement in a City of Toronto summer camp and receive a certificate upon completion.As this is a registered activity, participants will not receive credit for volunteer hours. For more information on volunteer opportunities, contact your local community centre.

programs.name: Adapted CampTO Explore
programs.description: Adapted CampTO Explore is a fun and creative camp experience for campers with a special need or a disability. Enjoy modified active and quiet games, arts and crafts, sports and more while making new friends. A workshop, a local trip or a visit from a special guest will add to the excitement.Participants must have a current AIS membership. For membership information contact the AIS Hotline at 416-395-6128 or email aiscw@toronto.ca.

programs.name: Dance: Salsa
programs.description: Bring the vibrancy of Salsa to the dance floor. Learn to perfect quick footwork and fluid hip movements through a variety of exercises and engaging choreography.

programs.name: Digital Art: Animated GIF (9-13 years)
programs.description: Design and create your very own GIF to send to firends or post online. Take home a high-resolution print out of one frame of your GIF and a USB with your completed work to send by e-mail or to print again at home.

programs.name: Digital Art: Character Design (9-13 years)
programs.description: Learn how to create a fun character and bring it to life digitally using computer software (Adobe Suite). Take home a high-resolution print of your character and a USB with your completed work in JPEG to send by e-mail or to print again at home.

programs.name: Digital Art: Manga Kids (9-13 years)
programs.description: Create your own step-by-step exciting Manga characters while learning the basics of Adobe Illustrator.  Take home a high-resolution print of your character and a USB with your completed work in JPEG to send by e-mail or to print again at home.

programs.name: Drawing
programs.description: Bring your imagination to life on paper. Learn the basics of how to draw using shapes and colours to create pictures with markers, crayons and pencil crayons.

programs.name: Drawing

programs.name: Drawing and Painting
programs.description: Explore your creativity through pencils, pastels, acrylic paint and watercolours. Learn about and practice skills including sketching, shading, brush strokes, use of colour and texture.

programs.name: Drawing in the Garden
programs.description: Using dry media like pencil, pencil crayon or charcoal, explore the many varieties of plants and flowers around the Clark Centre. Instruction on basic drawing technique such as shading, composition and line. Learn to see like an artist using observations and fill your sketchbook with unique and beautiful pieces. Portions of this class will take place out doors depending on weather. Materials list will be provided.

programs.name: Drawing: Portrait
programs.description: Portraits bring personality to paper. With basic instruction on how to draw your subject’s face and head, learn how to capture a subjects character in a variety of mediums such as pencil, charcoal, pastel and ink.

programs.name: Fitness with Family
programs.description: Do you like the idea of participating in physical activity with your family? Each week as you explore and try out various fitness activities, together as a family you will develop fitness fundamentals including balance, coordination and flexibility. The format of this class may vary from week to week. Each individual must register for this activity.

programs.name: Functional Fit
programs.description: This conditioning workout is designed to help you build strength to support day-to-day activities. At your own pace, you will practice basic movements like pushing, pulling, bending and squatting to improve your overall functional fitness.

programs.name: Functional Fit
programs.description: This conditioning workout is designed to help you build strength to support day-to-day activities. At your own pace, you will practice basic movements like pushing, pulling, bending and squatting to improve your overall functional fitness.

programs.name: Functional Mobility: TIME
programs.description: In partnership with University Health Network, Toronto Rehabilitation Institute, a modified exercise program suitable for adults with mobility challenges, who can walk at least 10 metres and may use a cane or walker. Exercises are designed to increase strength, balance, mobility and overall health. Participant screening is required prior to registration, please contact Christopher Keller at 647-214-0582 before registering for this program.You may bring a support person with you. FitnessTO memberships do not apply.Participants Must Be Able To:1. Walk 10 meters (2 lane residential street) without the help of another person. -Can use other kind of aide. -Speed and quality is not important 2. Follow instructions and demonstrations in small group setting.3. Safely stand and move with hand support for balance. 4. Rise from a chair on their own. For more information, registration assistance, or access to subsidy support, please contact 437-331-6325.www.uhn.ca/TorontoRehab/Clinics/TIME

programs.name: Fusing Glass Workshop: Earrings
programs.description: This is your opportunity to design beautiful unique glass earrings just for you. In this workshop, you will make three pairs of dichroic glass earrings including two pairs of studs and one pair of dangle earrings. Please bring $30 cash to the class for materials. Fusing occurs off-site and pick up of works to be coordinated with the instructor.

programs.name: Fusing Glass Workshop: Garden Piece
programs.description: Decorate a wooden shaped butterfly or a ladybug with glass to hang in your home or garden. Material fee of $30 (cash only) payable to instructor for materials. Fusing occurs off-site and pick up of works to be coordinated with the instructor.

programs.name: Fusing Glass Workshop: Jewellery Set
programs.description: Decorate a unique and vibrant set of jewellery for your individual style. Using colourful glass pieces, you will design a matching set comprised of a pair of earrings, a necklace pendant and a ring. Material fee of $35 (cash only) payable to instructor for materials. Fusing occurs off-site and pick-up of works to be coordinated with the instructor.

programs.name: Future Lifeguards
programs.description: Prepare to be a future lifeguard in this free activity. Here, swimmers will continue to develop the skills they need to successfully complete Bronze level courses, which are a requirement to become a lifeguard, as well as be encouraged to apply for City of Toronto recreation employment with the support of City staff.Prerequisite: You must be able to demonstrate 70% completion of the Future Lifeguard screening on week one of the program (Ultra 6/7 swimming ability). Candidates who do not meet this requirement will be referred to other City of Toronto swim programming.

programs.name: Games: Billiards (Women)
programs.description: From active to interactive and simple to strategic, games are a great way to gain new skills. In billiards, a game played on a table where a cue is used to strike a ball to make a play, you will learn stance, aim, alignment and striking as well as game rules. This Activity is for all women.

programs.name: Games: Billiards (Women)
programs.description: From active to interactive and simple to strategic, games are a great way to gain new skills. In billiards, a game played on a table where a cue is used to strike a ball to make a play, you will learn stance, aim, alignment and striking as well as game rules.

programs.name: Games: Chess
programs.description: From active to interactive and simple to strategic, games are a great way to gain new skills. In chess, a two-player game where game pieces are used to move across the board with the object to checkmate your opponent, you will learn patience, tactics and critical thinking as well as game rules.

programs.name: Games: Dungeons & Dragons
programs.description: From active to interactive and simple to strategic, games are a great way to gain new skills. In Dungeons & Dragons, a role-playing game, you will learn patience and problem solving as well as game rules.

programs.description: Adapted CampTO Explore is a fun and creative camp experience for campers with a special need or a disability. Enjoy modified active and quiet games, arts and crafts, sports and more while making new friends. A workshop, a local trip or a visit from a special guest will add to the excitement.Participants must have a current AIS membership. For membership information contact the AIS Hotline at 416-395-6128 or email aiscw@toronto.ca.
